name: Arcane Runes

faq.answer: You need rubbings of the Rune of Beth'Amara, the Rune of Jin'yael, the Rune of Markri, and the Rune of Sael'hai.
You make rubbings of the ancient stones using the Drawing Kit provided to you.
faq.q: How do you record the runes?

faq.answer: Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter is waiting to collect the completed rubbings on a small island off the southern peninsula of Azshara once you signal him.
faq.q: Who takes the finished rune rubbings?

faq.answer: He waits on a small island lying off the southern peninsula of Azshara.

sections.body: Four ancient markings await in Azshara: the Rune of Beth'Amara, the Rune of Jin'yael, the Rune of Markri, and the Rune of Sael'hai. Equipped with a Drawing Kit, you must take careful rubbings from each stone across the coastal ruins. Once the four copies are gathered, you make for a small island off the southern peninsula. There you will signal Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter to retrieve the records.
sections.title: Rubbings of Azshara

summary: Ancient runes scattered across Azshara hold secrets of the coast's forgotten past. With a drawing kit in hand, you are called to trace four distinct stones and signal Pilot Xiggs Fuselighter on a southern islet.
